document_dispositions.rationale: Independent full-document coverage review found no additional distinct target-wide current-objective fact beyond the four previously accepted CUSTOMER_OFFICIAL facts. The DDR5 and EPYC/Helios passages restate the already accepted advanced-DRAM and platform-collaboration meaning; the HBM4 performance language is product marketing rather than incremental customer commitment; the foundry discussion is outside the allowed MEMORY segment; and the generic forward-looking caution does not establish purchase price, committed volume, allocation, duration, cancellation rights, a signed purchase contract, or realized HBM revenue. Cumulative accepted fact count remains four.
